title: study.builder studies feed
description: One list of every study a reader can have from a study.builder site: studies with their data ready, settings that build one, and protocols a new study can follow. Version 1.

id.description: Names the entry for good. An id is never used again for another study.

kind.description: study: its data is in `file` and opens at once. settings: `settings` build it, with R. protocol: `file` is a protocol a new study can follow.

about.description: A sentence or two for a reader.

line.description: The facts in a line, ready to show: Phase 2 · 120 participants · 12 sites · 7 months.

facts.description: What the line is made of. A fact that does not apply is left out or null.

study.description: The study's id in its own tables.

participants.description: Simulated for a study or settings; planned for a protocol.

snapshots.description: How many monthly snapshots the study keeps: 1 is the last only.

file.description: The file to fetch, for a study or a protocol. A study file is gzipped JSON in the format study.builder/study/1; a protocol file is JSON in study.builder/protocol/1.

url.description: Relative to the feed's own address.

key.description: For a study: the key of its tables, as its manifest gives it.

settings.description: For an entry of settings: what StudyBuilder.buildStudy takes.
